objective: Authenticate the next dense/R-family representation suppliers and freeze a supplier-agnostic, per-class 44b6 separation-gate population without running a supplier, GPU job, graph, 6bba, or CV57.

population_freeze.source: Exact Phase-1 N1-valid, fit-only population already materialized under the frozen per-class amendment.
population_freeze.copy_policy: Do not copy or mutate the 43 MiB banked population. Emit a complete path/size/SHA-256 inventory and an aggregate digest in this lane.
population_freeze.labels: Exact single-action delta S(G); beneficial iff delta > 0 and harmful iff delta <= 0.
population_freeze.folds: Five identity-grouped OOF folds already encoded in every population shard.

authoritative_comparison_rules_unchanged.probe: class-balanced standardized ridge least-squares binary rank probe, lambda 0.01, deterministic float64
metrics: beneficial-action retention at exact CG0 per-video FP budget
authoritative_comparison_rules_unchanged.pass_semantics: Only unlock a newly frozen supplier x action_class 44b6 graph-gate preregistration for human review. No tier promotion and no graph authorization.
authoritative_comparison_rules_unchanged.fail_semantics: Park only the named supplier x action_class instantiation PARK-C. Do not kill the supplier family or the other action class.
authoritative_comparison_rules_unchanged.invalid_semantics: Any provenance, population, fold, alignment, metric, resource, or integrity violation produces no scientific verdict.

supplier_authentication_gate.missing_artifact_semantics: NOT_READY, not a scientific failure and not a tier move

sample_queue_rule.projection_basis: Authenticated measured same-implementation throughput plus explicit packaging and retry margin; never a literature runtime guess.
sample_queue_rule.scope: Exact frozen 44b6 population endpoint sample only; no full cache.

expected_terminal: READY_QUEUE if one or more non-R7 suppliers pass authentication and have an authenticated <5 h projection; otherwise PARK_NOT_READY while preserving all affected R-family nodes at their current tiers.
